def test_catalogue_workflow():
    # List catalogue
    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/catalogue"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    socks = resp.json()
    assert len(socks) > 0, "Expected at least one sock in catalogue"
    sock = socks[0]
    sock_id = sock["id"]

    # Get specific sock
    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", f"/catalogue/{sock_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["id"] == sock_id

    # Get tags
    resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", "/tags"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    tags = resp.json().get("tags", [])

    # Get size
    if tags:
        resp = requests.get(get_url("catalogue", f"/catalogue/size?tags={tags[0]}"), timeout=10)
        assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
        assert "size" in resp.json()

def test_user_registration_and_profile():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    password = "password123"
    email = f"{username}@example.com"

    # Register
    payload = {
        "username": username,
        "password": password,
        "email": email,
        "firstName": "Test",
        "lastName": "User"
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify registration via GET customer
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("firstName") == "Test"

    # Register again -> 409 Conflict
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json=payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 409, f"Expected 409, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Login
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", "/login"), auth=(username, password), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Add Address
    addr_payload = {
        "city": "London",
        "country": "UK",
        "number": "10",
        "postcode": "SW1A 1AA",
        "street": "Downing St",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/addresses"), json=addr_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    addr_id = resp.json()["id"]

    # Verify Address added
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}/addresses"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    addresses = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("address", [])
    assert any(a.get("id") == addr_id for a in addresses)

    # Add Card
    card_payload = {
        "ccv": "123",
        "expires": "12/25",
        "longNum": "1234567890123456",
        "userID": username
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/cards"), json=card_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    card_id = resp.json()["id"]

    # Verify Card added
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}/cards"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    cards = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("card", [])
    assert any(c.get("id") == card_id for c in cards)

    # Delete Customer
    resp = requests.delete(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("status") is True

    # Verify Deletion (GET returns empty customer with only username)
    resp = requests.get(get_url("user", f"/customers/{username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json().get("firstName") is None

def test_carts_management():
    customer_id = f"cust_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"
    item_id = "3395a43e-2d88-40de-b95f-e00e1502085b"

    # Add item
    item_payload = {
        "itemId": item_id,
        "quantity": 2,
        "unitPrice": 15.0
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), json=item_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify item added
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    items = resp.json()
    assert len(items) == 1
    assert items[0]["itemId"] == item_id
    assert items[0]["quantity"] == 2

    # Update item
    update_payload = {
        "itemId": item_id,
        "quantity": 5,
        "unitPrice": 15.0
    }
    resp = requests.patch(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), json=update_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify item updated
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["quantity"] == 5

    # Delete item
    resp = requests.delete(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify item deleted
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items/{item_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 404, f"Expected 404, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Delete cart
    resp = requests.delete(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 202, f"Expected 202, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"

    # Verify cart deleted (items should be empty)
    resp = requests.get(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{customer_id}/items"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert len(resp.json()) == 0

def test_orders_end_to_end():
    username = f"user_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"

    # Register
    requests.post(get_url("user", "/register"), json={
        "username": username, "password": "pw", "email": f"{username}@test.com",
        "firstName": "F", "lastName": "L"
    }, timeout=10)

    # Add Address
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/addresses"), json={
        "city": "C", "country": "C", "number": "1", "postcode": "123", "street": "S", "userID": username
    }, timeout=10)
    addr_id = resp.json()["id"]

    # Add Card
    resp = requests.post(get_url("user", "/cards"), json={
        "ccv": "123", "expires": "12/25", "longNum": "1234567890123456", "userID": username
    }, timeout=10)
    card_id = resp.json()["id"]

    # Add Item to Cart
    item_id = "3395a43e-2d88-40de-b95f-e00e1502085b"
    requests.post(get_url("carts", f"/carts/{username}/items"), json={
        "itemId": item_id, "quantity": 1, "unitPrice": 10.0
    }, timeout=10)

    # Create Order
    order_payload = {
        "customer": f"/customers/{username}",
        "address": f"/addresses/{addr_id}",
        "card": f"/cards/{card_id}",
        "items": f"/carts/{username}/items"
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("orders", "/orders"), json=order_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 201, f"Expected 201, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    order = resp.json()
    order_id = order["id"]

    assert order["customer"]["username"] == username
    assert order["address"]["number"] == "1"
    assert order["card"]["longNum"].endswith("3456")
    assert len(order["items"]) == 1
    assert order["items"][0]["itemId"] == item_id

    # Verify Order via GET
    resp = requests.get(get_url("orders", f"/orders/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["id"] == order_id

    # Verify Order Search
    resp = requests.get(get_url("orders", f"/orders/search/customerId?custId={username}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    orders = resp.json().get("_embedded", {}).get("customerOrders", [])
    assert any(o["id"] == order_id for o in orders)

    # Verify Payment Authorization recorded by order creation
    resp = requests.get(get_url("payment-http", f"/payments/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    payments = resp.json()
    assert len(payments) > 0
    assert payments[0]["orderId"] == order_id

    # Verify Shipment recorded by order creation
    resp = requests.get(get_url("shipping-http", f"/shipping/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    shipment = resp.json()
    assert shipment["orderId"] == order_id

def test_payment_and_shipping_direct():
    order_id = f"ord_{uuid.uuid4().hex[:8]}"

    # Authorize Payment
    payment_payload = {
        "address": {"city": "C", "country": "C", "number": "1", "postcode": "123", "street": "S"},
        "amount": 50.0,
        "card": {"ccv": "123", "expires": "12/25", "longNum": "1234567890123456"},
        "customer": {"firstName": "F", "lastName": "L"},
        "orderId": order_id
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("payment-http", "/payments"), json=payment_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    auth = resp.json()
    assert auth["orderId"] == order_id

    # Verify Payment recorded
    resp = requests.get(get_url("payment-http", f"/payments/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    payments = resp.json()
    assert len(payments) == 1
    assert payments[0]["orderId"] == order_id

    # Create Shipment
    shipping_payload = {
        "address": {"city": "C", "country": "C", "number": "1", "postcode": "123", "street": "S"},
        "itemCount": 2,
        "orderId": order_id
    }
    resp = requests.post(get_url("shipping-http", "/shipping"), json=shipping_payload, timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    shipment = resp.json()
    assert shipment["orderId"] == order_id

    # Verify Shipment recorded
    resp = requests.get(get_url("shipping-http", f"/shipping/{order_id}"), timeout=10)
    assert resp.status_code == 200, f"Expected 200, got {resp.status_code}: {resp.text}"
    assert resp.json()["orderId"] == order_id
